purpose: Operational v1 versus v6.1 comparison before a new-city activation decision; not ground-truth validation.

recommendation.decision: recommend new-city-only activation after owner review
recommendation.text: The v6.1 path is operationally ready for NEW cities behind CITY_COST_METHODOLOGY_V6=true, subject to owner review of this impact preview. Keep the flag off for the existing 121-city CSV and retain v1 as the rollback.
limitations: This is not ground-truth validation and should not be interpreted as accuracy.
Food and activity values are BudgetYourTrip source-backed product estimates; drinks are Numbeo-backed consumption presets with modelled cocktail composition.
